name: Türkiye — Kariyer Kapısı public recruitment
authority: Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye — Kariyer Kapısı
notes: Official public recruitment portal identified by its Presidency footer. Current reader shows institution, active-notice and closing-date headings with search controls; absent rows do not prove no vacancies. Appointment type, international-applicant permission and formal language level require each employer’s original notice. Turkish interface does not establish an applicant language threshold.
accessGap: Reader-only discovery awaiting review; no adapter, retained originals, accepted connector or published cycle. Dynamic notice inventory, original advertisements, institution-specific nationality/residence, qualifications, appointment tenure, language rules and deadline timezone remain unverified. FAQ reader currently fails; earlier Phase 78 observation is not a fresh successful fetch. Collection permission, complete authority inventory and other pathways remain gaps.
licence: Official public-authority reader-only discovery. Original notices, collection terms, translations and extracted summaries require review before connector acceptance or publication.

name: Morocco — Emploi Public recruitment competitions
authority: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform, Morocco
notes: Ministry confirms official recruitment portal; recruitment competitions, senior posts, responsibility posts, experts and staff mobility are distinct routes. Sample C43846/26 Civil Engineering State Engineer notice is regular recruitment for one post. Its Arabic original requires Moroccan nationality; foreign-degree equivalence does not grant foreign-citizen eligibility. Window 23 September–7 October 2026 at 16:30; official timezone unestablished. No formal language threshold verified; Arabic original and French interface are not proficiency levels.
accessGap: Reader/browser-only discovery awaiting review; no adapter, retained originals, accepted connector or published cycle. Sample nationality rule applies only to C43846/26, not every public employer. Permanent tenure, complete candidate qualifications, amendments, deadlines/timezone and exact venue notices require review. PDF read visually on all three pages but not retained or hash-accepted. Portal result count and repeated selection/result notices are not distinct-cycle totals. Collection terms, full national/local/public-enterprise inventory and other pathways remain gaps.
licence: Official public-authority reader-only discovery. Original notices, collection terms, translations and extracted summaries require review before connector acceptance or publication.

name: Tunisia — National Public Recruitment Competition Portal
authority: Government of Tunisia — National Public Recruitment Competition Portal
notes: National portal identifies civil-service and public-sector recruitment competitions. News includes announcements and selection results, which must not create duplicate cycles. Sample Hammamet municipality news dated 25 September 2026 describes external test-based recruitment for a temporary category A1 civil engineer under a 19 June 2026 decision. National-ID login does not establish foreign-citizen eligibility. Arabic interface is not a proficiency requirement; no formal language level verified.
accessGap: Reader-only discovery awaiting review; no adapter, retained originals, accepted connector or published cycle. Municipal organization/opening decisions and original current applications need review. Sample announcement gives no verified window, timezone, full qualifications or nationality rule. It prints a non-government recruitment-domain spelling that remains unverified and is not adopted as an application link. Portal introduction request failed after an initial response; do not treat failure as closure or checked-empty coverage. Complete public-authority inventory, terms, translations and other pathways remain gaps.
licence: Official public-authority reader-only discovery. Original notices, collection terms, translations and extracted summaries require review before connector acceptance or publication.
